Sam Torres: Hey team — Veridian Labs sent back the vendor risk form. They want a specific answer on embeddings storage encryption and key management. I'll paste the snippet.
Anita Kumar: Thanks. Can you drop the question text? I can propose an answer.
Sam Torres: "Do you store or cache embeddings derived from customer data? If so, how are they encrypted at rest and who controls the keys?"
Leo Park: Short answer: we do not persist customer embeddings in Hosted mode unless customer opts in. For Dedicated/Private customers, embeddings can be stored; key control depends on deployment (Redwood-managed KMS for hosted, customer KMS/HSM for Private).
Anita Kumar: Proposed language: "By default, Redwood does not persist customer-generated embeddings in Hosted mode. For customers who enable embedding storage or use Dedicated/Private deployments, data at rest is encrypted using AES-256; key management is configurable — Redwood-managed KMS for Hosted, or customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Dedicated/Private. Access to stored embeddings is restricted by RBAC and audit logging." :thumbsup:
Sam Torres: Nice. Veridian also asked about retention controls and deletion APIs.
Leo Park: Add: "Retention is configurable per-tenant with a default ephemeral retention of 7 days for non-stored caches. Customers can request immediate deletion via the Delete Tenant Data API (POST /v1/tenants/:id/delete) and we provide evidence exports for compliance."
Anita Kumar: I'll turn that into a short paragraph and send back to them. Also note: for on-prem, customer controls networking and keys.
Sam Torres: Perfect. Can you paste the text into the questionnaire doc and I'll send? Also cc legal if needed.
Leo Park: Pasting now —
```
Embeddings and Storage: By default, embeddings generated during inference are not persisted in Redwood Hosted. Where embeddings are stored (opt-in Dedicated/Private deployments), they are encrypted with AES-256 at rest. Key management options: Redwood-managed KMS (Hosted) or customer-managed KMS/HSM (Dedicated/Private). Retention is tenant-configurable; customers may request deletion via our Delete Tenant Data API and receive a compliance evidence report on request.
```
Sam Torres: Sent to Veridian, flagged legal just in case. Closing this thread — thanks all :heart:
